verdict_reason: Counting the book as the sum of the three type tabs and adding background addresses through the type page match the ins-frontend's routes and redirects; two Major structure findings (a one-use selector at module scope, an unreachable no-detail branch in the error builder).

todos.issue: RESULTS_LABEL ('[data-testid="address-book-results-label"]') sits at module scope but only tabAddressCount (line 58) reads it; the house rule puts a literal used by one function inside that function (this PR applied that rule to editedTown in front-door.js but not here).
todos.fix: Must: the results-label selector lives inside the one function that reads it. One way: move it into tabAddressCount as a local const.

todos.issue: unreadableVolumeError(datastore, detail) branches on a missing detail (`detail ? ` (${detail})` : ''`), but every caller this PR writes passes one (lines 33, 39, 52, 62), so the no-detail branch is unreachable code.
todos.fix: Must: unreadableVolumeError has no branch no caller reaches. One way: make detail required and always append ` (${detail})`.
